{{Quote|Republic SIS raided an Imperial Intelligence base on Nar Shaddaa. This information was among dozens of classified data files they recovered.|Leeha Narezz|<ref name="Suicide Squads" />}}
Around [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]], the Republic's intelligence agency, conducted a '''raid''' on a [[Imperial Intelligence base|base]] of their rival organization, [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The SIS [[Agent/Legends|agents]] were able to recover a significant number of classified data files from the base, and upon discovering that one of the files included information on a [[Unidentified Imperial scientist|scientist]] who had worked on the [[Emperor's Fortress|space station]] of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], the SIS forwarded the file to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tol Braga]]. Braga [[Mission to Hoth (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|dispatched]] the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leeha Narezz]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in order to recover the [[Deference|scientist's shuttle]] and the station's technical readouts as part of his [[Hunt for the Sith Emperor|plan to capture the Emperor]].<ref name="Suicide Squads" />

==Behind the scenes==
The raid was first mentioned in the mission "Suicide Squads" for the Jedi Knight class in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Suicide Squads" />
